ROOTED IN FAMILY, GROWN WITH LOVE

Wild Grown Farm is a family owned and operated edible plant nursery and pastured poultry farm in beautiful Central Oregon. We specialize in heirloom and open-pollinated plant starts including vegetables, fruits, herbs, and flowers. We raise a diverse array of pastured poultry including chickens, ducks, turkeys and geese. We steward our land using permaculture principles and regenerative farming practices in our quest to cultivate the world we wish to see for our children. We invite you to follow along with our story on social media or subscribing to our newsletter to keep up to date with happening on the farm!

OUR PLEDGE

Together as a community, we affirm the presence, participation, and fundamental worth of each member— celebrating the diversity represented in age, gender, race, ethnicity, origins, religion, sexual orientation, ability, political viewpoints, and socioeconomic status. Looking to nature as our guide, we celebrate many and differing points of view, knowing that diversity is the backbone for a resilient community.

HELLO! WE’RE THE KANE FAMILY. 

SHANNON KANE

Having been born and raised in Central Oregon, our move from urban farm to rural life felt like a true homecoming. I am deeply passionate about all things local agriculture and am beyond proud to produce high-quality food for my community.  One thing I love just as much as growing food is eating it and would consider myself a enthusastic foodie. I’m very involved in my community and wholeheartedly believe in the role of grassroots organization in shaping our lives. When I’m not in the fields you can find me homeschooling my kids, digging into a good book, or enjoying a long hike around the Cascades. I have a MA in Environmental Leadership from Naropa University with a focus in sustainable and equitable food systems and am a trained Permaculture Designer. 

TAYLOR KANE 

Taylor grew up in Portland with a very traditional lifestyle in mind until he met Shannon. He has always been drawn to the idea of living a self-sufficient lifestyle, but is now striving towards that goal. While we aren’t yet there, he is always trying to move our lives onto the next step in the right direction. He takes pride in the hard work he does for the farm, and our community, and is always willing to learn and get his hands dirty. Taylor handles the financial aspects, building, watering, and harvesting on the farm. When Taylor is not working on things for the farm, he is either working his full-time job assisting business owners to provide benefits to their employees, outside playing around with our children and pets, or fixing up our 1916 farm home.  He holds a MBA from Pacific University and loves to play soccer when given the chance.

EDIBLE PLANTS, GROWN WITH LOVE
GET THE HEALTHIEST AND HIGHEST QUALITY START TO YOUR 2026 GROWING SEASON!

    We value the trust our customers place in us to provide them with the highest quality, chemical-free, and sustainably produced nursery stock. Our plant starts are grown using organic, heirloom, and open-pollinated seeds in organic potting soil. We choose varieties that grow well in our climate and specialize in plants for high-desert growers, including our signature mixed variety six-packs. Additionally, all of our plants are inoculated with beneficial fungi to give them extra vigor and resistance to transplant shock. Every plant we sell we have tended with our own hands and with great care.

WE WILL NOT BE OFFERING ONLINE ORDERS IN 2026

But don’t worry! You can still grab our plants at our local partners and at our farm pick up dates.
